name: Detection Engineering Portfolio Coverage
description: ATT&CK techniques covered by detections in this portfolio. Green = stable (validated in lab), Yellow = experimental.

techniques.comment: Stable — Sigma rule validated via Atomic Red Team T1547.001 Test 1 in home lab. See detections/persistence/T1547.001-registry-run-keys/
Experimental — Sigma rule validated via Atomic Red Team T1059.001 Test 1 in home lab. See detections/execution/T1059.001-PowerShell-Execution/

Experimental — mshta arm of the shared proxy-execution rule. Sigma base validated on a Chainsaw EID 1 fixture batch (18/18); SPL grading verified in Splunk. No Atomic Red Team (EDR blocks T1218 tests at process creation). See detections/defence-evasion/T1218.005-System-Binary-Proxy-Execution/

Experimental — regsvr32/Squiblydoo arm of the shared proxy-execution rule. Remote /i:http is creation-blocked by Defender on the lab host, so the fixture uses /i:ftp. See detections/defence-evasion/T1218.005-System-Binary-Proxy-Execution/

Experimental — rundll32 arm of the shared proxy-execution rule, including comsvcs MiniDump. Known gap: proxy binary spawning a shell is handed off to T1059.001. See detections/defence-evasion/T1218.005-System-Binary-Proxy-Execution/
